name: Mechanical stop latch in engaged state
aliases: Mechanical stop latch in engaged state symbol
Mechanical stop latch in engaged state IEC reference
summary: This form identifies an engaged stop-latch mechanism.
description: This form identifies an engaged stop-latch mechanism. The state describes mechanical retention. The affected device can have separate electrical contacts reporting that position, so engagement is not equivalent to energisation.

State which movement is restrained and what documented release action changes the condition. Where feedback is used, cross-reference its actual contact rather than treating the latch mark as an electrical output.
readingNotes: State which movement is restrained and what releases the latch.
An engaged latch does not automatically indicate a circuit is energised.
